Asset type: one full-body transparent tactical mission-unit animation master, C01-MISSION-RELEASED-VETERAN. Change ONLY the pose of the elderly woman in the reference image, preserving her exact identity, costume, palette, anatomy and chunky matte drawing style.
Invariants: same elderly warm-tan woman, same short swept gray hair with small low bun and gold hoop earring, broad kind face, green neck scarf, gray long coat with the SAME large patches, brown inner top, dark gray skirt, huge brown boots, extremely short sturdy legs, large head and hands. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands. ONE brown wooden cane remains in screen-left near hand; ONE thick broken OPEN gold control collar with conspicuous gap remains in screen-right far hand, with the SAME two large iron chain links and ONE iron key dangling. Collar is never worn around neck. No armor, helmet or weapons.
Keep the identical three-quarter screen-right view, camera distance and whole-canvas scale. Same 1584x993 landscape canvas; head crown stays about y46, boot support near y933, head height and body proportions exactly unchanged. Use the full canvas, no cropped/reframed composition. Generous transparent side margins, at least 20 transparent pixels below lowest sole or cane. Anatomical pose can shift mildly while scale stays fixed. Source art will be downscaled at one common scale, never fit per pose.
Style: huge head/hands, broad compressed torso, very short legs and huge boots. Bold near-black contours, broad muted matte color planes, two or three simple large shadow planes. Clear at 44 logical pixels. Preserve clean chunky shapes; no new detail, tiny texture, grain, thin decorative detail or gloss.

POSE WALK-A, first genuine walking step: screen-RIGHT far boot swings FORWARD toward screen-right, clearly lifted off the ground with toe tilted upward, knee slightly bent under gray skirt. Screen-LEFT near boot stays planted as the supporting rear foot near its idle location. Widen separation of boots visibly; expose distinct short legs, move skirt hem naturally with stride. Left hand moves cane slightly ahead, cane tip planted near support plane left of the body. Right arm and open gold collar swing gently backward, hanging chain/key follows. Keep body upright with slight forward walking lean and same calm face. This is a real stepping pose, not the idle with moved accessories.
Constraints: ONE whole character on true transparent RGBA; no ground, floor, cast shadow, base, backdrop, magenta, glow, aura, haze, text, symbols, extra objects, detached marks or extra limbs. Preserve generated alpha.
